blocking_defects.affected_invariant: The pre-apply validator must preserve distinct candidate-postimage and material-package digest identities while cryptographically binding the parsed material package, its producer receipt, and the ready handoff to one exact material-package digest.

evidence.source_observation: The pre-apply branch accepts material_receipt.packageDigest when it is any 64-character string, repeats it through the handoff checks, and never recomputes the parsed material package's canonical digest or compares that result to the receipt value.

blocking_defects.impact: A stale or fabricated material-package digest can pass the pre-apply gate when the receipt and handoff repeat it, even though it is not the digest of the supplied material package. The required candidate-to-material bridge is therefore not proven and exact-byte owner acceptance must not be requested from this review.
blocking_defects.minimal_repair: Recompute the material package digest from the exact parsed package using the producer's declared canonical digest algorithm, require equality with the producer receipt's packageDigest, preserve the distinct candidate digest binding through review and owner acceptance, and add a negative regression in which only the receipt and handoff material digest are changed. Regenerate all acceptance-bound candidate metadata, validation evidence, and the independent-review request after repair.
